description: List the standing rules of the person whose key you use: "agent X may do <action> on <scope> without asking me", with expiry and how often each was used. A task or question matching one exactly is approved without asking that person. Read-only: rules are added, edited and revoked by the person in AppCrane (Crew → Rules & blocks, or "Approve and always allow" on a question). Production and deletions are never covered.
name: appcrane_crew_rules
